title: Mini toy advent calendar
text: Mini toy advent calendar. I purchased this for my 9 year grandson... I've tried several different calendars over his life... he is harder and harder to please.  His Mom reports he likes this one.  There is a different tiny die cast toy in each day so far...  It's low tech - but Mom says he smiles each day - so that's good.
